name: dsh-balance-widget
description: Balance & cost widget for the DeepSeek Harness GUI (web and desktop app): a sidebar footer card shows the DeepSeek account balance and today's costs; clicking opens a popover with a five-tier cost breakdown (last prompt with session name / today-this-session / today-this-workspace / today-all-workspaces), peak/off-peak status tag, term explanations, and a one-click top-up link. Zero external dependencies — works on Node 24.
